sources.label: Streamex first independent GLDY reserve attestation

reserveReview.rationale: Streamex describes GLDY as backed by investment-grade gold bullion, with some bullion leased through Monetary Metals while title remains with the issuer. The July 2026 independent examination announcement reports redemption assets measured in fine troy ounces at or above GLDY obligations; the Chainlink feed supplies the current on-chain reserve observation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Streamex issuer disclosure, independent reserve attestation, and Chainlink Proof of Reserve
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reviewed sources establish the physical-gold reserve category but do not disclose current bar-level custody allocation, lease-counterparty concentration, or redemption timing for each reserve position.
